title: 控制方案复杂且缺乏引导
description: 控制方案非标准、晦涩复杂，缺乏必要的引导和说明，玩家难以理解操作方式，导致上手困难。
evidence: the controls are deliberately obtuse and complicated and it makes it a nightmare to try and get into for new players
The top down camera and the way the tiles work is weird to get used to at first (took me like 3 hours to figure out how to take the sensor off and not the floor)

evidence_items.quote: it punishes you for not immediately knowing the wonky control set
evidence_items.description: 操作方式别扭且缺乏说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它会因为你没有立刻掌握那套别扭的操作方式而惩罚你

evidence_items.quote: практически отсутствуют какие-то кнопки для управление как таковые
evidence_items.description: 缺少管理飞船和船员的控制按键
evidence_items.quote_zh: 几乎不存在什么用于操作的按键本身

evidence_items.quote: a control scheme that's slightly non-standard
evidence_items.description: 控制方案非标准，需要适应
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一套略微非标准的控制方案

evidence_items.quote: After you figure out the controls
its controls and tutorials could use some refinement
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它的操作和教程可以再打磨一下

evidence_items.quote: many of the game's unique and skeumorphic controls are counter-intuitive in ways that may confuse a beginner player
evidence_items.description: 独特拟物控制方式反直觉，可能让新手困惑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的许多独特且拟物化的控制方式在某种程度上反直觉，可能会让新手玩家感到困惑

evidence_items.quote: the controls are deliberately obtuse and complicated and it makes it a nightmare to try and get into for new players
evidence_items.description: 飞船控制故意设计得晦涩复杂，新手难以入门
evidence_items.quote_zh: 控制是故意做得晦涩又复杂，这让新玩家想要上手成了一场噩梦

evidence_items.quote: The top down camera and the way the tiles work is weird to get used to at first (took me like 3 hours to figure out how to take the sensor off and not the floor)
evidence_items.description: 俯视视角和瓷砖操作方式难以适应，例如花了3小时才学会取下传感器而不是地板
evidence_items.quote_zh: 俯视视角和地块的运作方式一开始有点奇怪，需要适应（我花了大概3个小时才搞明白怎么拆下传感器而不是地板）

evidence_items.quote: the controls are just bad.  Plain and simple.  Everything is manual, but in an unintuitive and not fun way.
evidence_items.description: 游戏控制过于手动且不直观，例如必须手动脱鞋才能穿压力服。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 操控就是很糟糕。简单明了。一切都是手动的，但方式既不直观也不有趣。

evidence_items.quote: it basically throws you into space with no instructions. Which in many games is fine, with an intuitive system you can figure things out as you go. But the systems here are all backwards, lack readablity
evidence_items.description: 控制系统不直观，没有说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它基本上就是把你扔进太空，没有任何说明。这在很多游戏里没问题，只要系统直观，你可以边玩边摸索。但这里的系统全是反着来的，缺乏可读性
